## Goal
Establish Lord Cricket XXVI as a repeatable, tested Codex development project on the recovered `main` branch. This is the **first Codex task**, not an authorisation to start M7K or change the gameplay model.

## Starting evidence
- Private repo: `SamForbes70/lord-cricket-xxvi`
- Current migration HEAD at handover: `b8e38e9614fc4340218033b8c42b5a0162e2cf3b`.
- Historical Pass 22 / M7J source: `5b8b9da990d657197fb56bbfd33152f87b875f5c`.
- Repo instructions: `AGENTS.md`; full task: `docs/codex-migration/FIRST_CODEX_TASK.md`.
- Runtime: Node.js >=22.12, npm, Python 3. TypeScript monorepo and browser-based Vite app.
- Existing alpha is `SYNTHETIC_ALPHA`; M7F-J research only, not production.

## Work requested
1. Read `AGENTS.md`, `CODEX_START_HERE.md`, `docs/codex-migration/FIRST_CODEX_TASK.md`, `docs/CAPABILITY_MATRIX.md`, `docs/NEXT_PASS.md`, relevant ADRs.
2. Verify Git ancestry, clean checkout, dependency/toolchain versions, package-lock integrity; do not modify frozen scoring, RNG, generator or match-event contracts.
3. Run `npm ci`, `npm run schemas:check`, `npm run build`, `npm run typecheck`, `npm run lint`, unit suites, scoring/RNG/probability/generator vectors, management full-season acceptance, and Python M7 tests where data and toolchain permit.
4. On authorised **local Windows** browser host, install Playwright browsers as needed and execute real Chromium/Firefox tests, IndexedDB save and restore, keyboard/150% UI, season management, and portable career export/import. Cloud-only tests must not be mislabelled Windows/browser acceptance.
5. Record `PASS / FAIL / BLOCKED / NOT RUN` per gate, exact commands and logs. Do not count inherited historical results as fresh execution.
6. Create `docs/codex-migration/CODEX_ENVIRONMENT_ACCEPTANCE.md` and recommend one bounded next pass. Fix only evidenced blockers with regression coverage; keep the initial work on a separate branch/PR and do not automatically merge.

## Acceptance
- Baseline identity checked and historical git ancestry preserved.
- Environment and test matrix with transparent evidence, including known blockers.
- No silent data migrations; no fake empirical promotion or exaggerated T20 scoring realism.
- Clearly documented, reproducible next development task.

## Important
The Cricsheet raw JSON archive is not tracked in this repo, and personal IndexedDB saves are not bundled. Both should be handled separately when explicitly available.

## Acceptance reconciliation after merged PR #2

The owner authorised the current steps 1–4 status/diagnostic pass. Baseline recovery and presentation fixes are merged through PR #2 (036c212). The source and archive checks, deterministic gates, hosted Linux/Windows browser suites, and owner-reported Windows Edge playthrough have passing evidence. The supplied original release passes 23 manifest hashes and all 894 historical source-file comparisons; 16 HTTP asset checks pass.

The location-specific Windows requirement remains distinct:

| Gate | Current evidence |
| --- | --- |
| Native Windows Chromium/Firefox automation | PASS on hosted GitHub Windows runners: 6 match UI and 4 portable career tests. |
| Owner-PC installation/build | PASS from supplied Node v24.22.0 and successful install/build output. |
| Owner-PC Edge human match | PASS by Sam's report, including layout and repeat replay verification. |
| Owner-PC Chromium/Firefox automation | NOT RUN; no direct owner-PC execution result supplied. |
| Exact local OS/browser versions, viewport and tested commit | NOT RECORDED. |
| Separate keyboard-focus, eligibility-reason and terminal-control observations | NOT RECORDED individually beyond the successful overall playthrough. |
| Reference-hardware performance | NOT RUN. |

Decision: retain the original local-Windows automation criterion. Hosted Windows tests are complementary evidence, not a silent replacement. Keep this issue open for the residual local gate. No missing human observation is marked passed, and no repeat full match is required merely to recreate the retained successful result. The reconciliation is documented in docs/ACCEPTANCE_RECONCILIATION.md on the separate status-and-quality branch/PR. This changes neither gameplay model status nor research-promotion permissions.
title: Codex 00: verify Windows environment and accept recovered Pass 22 baseline
